title: 2026–2027 History Radcliffe Alumnae Professor Harvard University
bio: Erika Lee is a historian, the author of five books on Asian American and immigration history, and the Bae Family Professor of History and the Pforzheimer Foundation Director of the Arthur and Elizabeth Schlesinger Library on the History of Women in America at Harvard University.
